title: Colorectal cancer sidedness: prognostic implications and the predictive role of artificial intelligence.
summary: Primary BMC article and Research Square V1 agree on a 71-patient retrospective CRC cohort and decision-tree prediction of laterality/prognostic outcomes. The small, single-center models have uneven/overfit results, so these are exploratory associations.
ai_technology: J48/C4.5 trees integrate clinicopathological data; LOOCV tests laterality and recurrence/mortality predictions.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Primary BMC article and Research Square V1 agree on a 71-patient retrospective CRC cohort and decision-tree prediction of laterality/prognostic outcomes. The small, single-center models have uneven/overfit results, so these are exploratory associations.
evidence.unknown: Internal LOOCV only; poor recurrence model and small cohort are explicitly acknowledged. Observed sidedness associations are cohort-specific, not causal.
